new_claims.statement: Repeated quadratic trace bounds reproduce product-width cost; conjugate outputs equal relative norm.
Exact count of ideals containing coefficient-short vectors bounds conditional-family probability; constant factor unavailable for almost all intended lifted ideals.
Canonical smoothing at least sqrt(N log(2/eps)/pi), and bounded canonical Gaussian nonzero output probability exponentially small.
Direct binary digit packing preserves base-multiplier products but not full extension multiplier/response law; a field-retraction condition rules out the stated one-projection interface.
